It gathers real sources, teaches the material properly, writes the clas"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"s notes down, and quizzes you before claiming you have learned anything."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This is a real plugin, not a prompt snippet: a switchable session mode, a teaching protocol injected"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" into every model request, three tools the model has to use, and course files that survive the sessi"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"to every model request, three tools the model has to use, and course files that survive the session."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Stage | Behaviour | Enforced by |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| 1. Gather | `web_search` / `web_fetch` for authoritative sources (textbooks, university course pag"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"es, standards, papers), with titles and URLs recorded; parallel subagents when a lesson needs many |"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" teaching protocol + the existing web tools |
| 2. Explain | why it matters → intuition/analogy → pr"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ecise definition (every symbol defined before use) → derivation → a fully worked example → usual mis"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"conceptions → how it connects | teaching protocol |
| 3. Notes | after each lesson, `edu_notes` writ"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"es the explanation, key points, pitfalls and sources into the course notes file | `edu_notes` tool |"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"
| 4. Quiz | at the end of each lesson, `edu_quiz` asks you questions in the conversation's own ques"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"tion UI, grades them, and re-teaches anything you missed with new examples | `edu_quiz` tool |
| 5. "},{"id":"p8s9","text":"Progress | once a module's quizzes back it, `edu_course` checks it off; progress persists across ses"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"sions | `edu_course` tool |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The three tools:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **`edu_course`** — `open` creates or rewrites the syllabus (goal, level, module checklist, sources"},{"id":"p10s2","text":") and makes it the session's active course; `status` reports progress and the next module; `complete"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"` checks a module off.
- **`edu_notes`** — writes the class notes for one lesson (body + key points "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"+ misconceptions + sources). A second write for the same lesson is refused unless `replace: true` is"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" passed.
- **`edu_quiz`** — asks, collects answers through the interactive question UI, grades, and "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"logs the result. Choice questions are graded automatically (single- and multi-select); open question"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"s are handed back for the model to judge. With no interactive channel (headless, ACP, a subagent), i"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"t degrades gracefully: the questions come back to the model to ask in chat instead of failing."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Course files"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Written under `edu-notes/<course>/` in the session workspace:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Course names are slugified (CJK preserved, path separators removed), so `/edu 线性代数` yields `edu-note"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"mes are slugified (CJK preserved, path separators removed), so `/edu 线性代数` yields `edu-notes/线性代数/`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The plugin is a standard DSH bundle (`dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml`). The built `lib/` is committ"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ed, so **no build-script permission is needed**."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> **How you install matters.** Use npm, a tarball or a git install: those unpack a real directory in"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"to the profile's `node_modules`. Do *not* use `dsh plugin add <directory>` — that is pnpm's `link:`,"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" and Node resolves the symlink to the source directory, so the plugin's `@deepseek-ai/*` imports bin"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"d to the source checkout's own `node_modules` and load a **second copy of cordis / dsh-tools**, whic"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"h the harness cannot recognise as a plugin. Developing inside a DSH source checkout (`pnpm dsh` + `-"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"-patch`) is unaffected."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"When running from a source checkout, replace `dsh` with `pnpm dsh`. To uninstall: `dsh plugin -"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"-profile web remove dsh-edu-mode`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The plugin's `config` in `cordis.patch.yml`, validated strictly at load (a typo fails loudly instead"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" of silently defaulting):"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"`/edu` is the switch:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Command | Effect |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| `/edu linear algebra` | turns education mode on, sets the course, and sends your text to the model"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" as the request |
| `/edu` | turns the mode on with no course yet; the model asks what you want to s"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"tudy |
| `/edu status` | shows the current state and course |
| `/edu off` | leaves education mode |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"A typical opener:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"After that the protocol drives the session: gather sources → teach one module → write the notes → qu"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"iz → re-teach whatever the quiz exposed. You can interrupt at any point ("explain that again", "hard"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"er questions", "skip this section")."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Mode state lives in the session log (the `edu/mode` event, last one wins), so resuming or forking a "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"session restores the mode and its course; course progress lives in the workspace files and is theref"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"ore also available across sessions."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Releasing"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Releases run on GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/release.yml`): pushing a version tag builds, test"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"s, publishes to npm, and creates a GitHub Release with the packed tarball attached."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"**One-time setup:** create an npm **Automation** token (npmjs.com → Access Tokens) and add it as the"},{"id":"p36s2","text":" repository secret `NPM_TOKEN` (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions). Without it the workflow"},{"id":"p36s3","text":" fails loudly at the publish step instead of skipping silently."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Listing on dsh-market"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"`dsh-market` — the plugin market inside DSH — **installs only from sources listed in the curated reg"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"istry**, and that catalog is generated from `data/plugins/*.yml` in `awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"plugin` (site: https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com). Getting listed is therefore **one pull request that "},{"id":"p39s4","text":"adds one file**, not a submission to a service."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"- Mode state is per session; `/edu off` does not affect other sessions.
- Only machine-checkable que"},{"id":"p42s2","text":"stions are graded automatically; open questions depend on the model's judgement, which receives the "},{"id":"p42s3","text":"reference answer with the response.
- Notes are keyed by course name: two courses with the same name"},{"id":"p42s4","text":" are one course, and renaming a course starts a new one.
- Education mode does not restrict other to"},{"id":"p42s5","text":"ols — the protocol states that understanding is the deliverable, but the model can still be asked to"},{"id":"p42s6","text":"states that understanding is the deliverable, but the model can still be asked to do something else."}],"truncated":true}
